title: The big coaches' DMs
hook: Setty, in the club seat across the coach's rented private jet: You still answer your own [bleep]ing DMs, right?

caption:
Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build a free AI setter for your Instagram DMs. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: why the biggest coaches never answer their own DMs, from their own job posts.

1. Big accounts hire people to answer their DMs. One public job post from a coach with 363K followers promised "a ton of leads coming in for you".

2. Their setup splits the work: the coach makes content, the setter answers the DMs, the closer takes the calls.

3. Solo, you do all three, and your evenings go to the inbox. Hiring isn't cheap either: a US appointment setter makes about $13 to $21 an hour plus commission (PayScale).

4. Setty is the AI setter I built for coaches: he answers in your voice through Manychat, only gives your calendar to serious leads, and you can jump into any chat yourself.

The catch: Setty isn't free once he's live. Building and testing are free with no card, then going live starts a 14-day trial at $119/month per live setter.
